_comment: Pre-retrieval guardrails. If the user's message matches any pattern in a rule, the agent refuses immediately with that rule's message — no embedding, no LLM call. Patterns are Python regex, matched case-insensitively with re.search(). Edit freely and restart the server to apply. Keep patterns tight to avoid refusing genuine Parkar questions.

rules.name: arithmetic
rules.message: I'm Parkar's assistant, so I can't act as a calculator — I stick to questions about Parkar. Ask me about our services, platforms or policies!

rules.name: code-generation
rules.message: I'm Parkar's assistant — I don't write or debug code. I can tell you about Parkar's engineering platforms and services, though!

rules.name: translation
rules.message: I'm Parkar's assistant and can't help with translation — but I'm happy to answer anything about Parkar!

rules.name: creative-writing
rules.message: I'm Parkar's assistant, so creative writing isn't something I do — but ask me anything about Parkar!
